meta.title: Canada Rockies · Vancouver + Canmore base loop
meta.assumption: Updated: wake/start 08:00; CX814 HKG 11:05 to YVR 07:40 on 23 Sep 2026; Vancouver city is reached on 5 Oct 2026; 6 Oct is a full Vancouver city / McArthurGlen day; CX867 departs YVR 14:10 on 7 Oct 2026 and arrives HKG 19:20 on 8 Oct.

flights.note: Arrival time is local Vancouver time.
Arrival is the next calendar day in Hong Kong.

days.label: Day 1 · Arrival in Vancouver
days.route: CX814 · HKG 11:05 → YVR 07:40 · airport arrival → McArthurGlen → Vancouver hotel
days.focus: Land at 07:40, clear the airport properly, then shop only if the flight and energy cooperate.

blocks.title: YVR arrival, immigration and bags
blocks.detail: CX814 is scheduled to arrive at 07:40 local time. Allow immigration, baggage, customs and a first coffee.

blocks.title: Transfer / luggage plan
blocks.detail: Take the Canada Line or hotel transfer. Store luggage only with a service confirmed in advance.

blocks.detail: The only outlet in this plan. Keep the visit short and protect baggage capacity; skip it if arrival is delayed.

blocks.title: Outlet coffee / light lunch
blocks.detail: Keep receipts and avoid bulky purchases until baggage limits are clear.

route_legs.note: Scenic Sea-to-Sky start, then interior overnight.
Revelstoke, Golden and Yoho are stop candidates, not guaranteed attractions.
Canmore is the main economical base; parking and park-pass logistics still matter.
Moraine Lake requires reserved shuttle or licensed access.
Icefields Parkway is the attraction, not a simple transfer.
Return to Canmore on 3 Oct, then begin the westbound return on 4 Oct.
4 Oct return overnight through Yoho and Rogers Pass.
Arrive and sleep in Vancouver city on 5 Oct.
